containsText.text: Automatically create BCH widgets in seconds

replaceAllText.replaceText: Money you share, where everyone spends alone from a budget they agreed to and bigger payments need the group. Bitcoin Cash enforces the rules, not us.

containsText.text: The BCH BLAZE team were making slides for project presentations and suddenly it hit us! What if people’s widgets could be produced in a factory instead of by hand?

replaceAllText.replaceText: Sara, Sam and Lee share a flat. One of them always fronts the groceries and chases the others. A joint card means trusting whoever holds it; a 2-of-3 multisig means three phones for a $20 shop.

containsText.text: Bob suggested his garage as our workshop & it went from there. We’re amazed by the quantity of widgets we can produce now!

replaceAllText.replaceText: With Venn they agree once: $50 a day each, anything bigger needs 2 of 3, and a lost phone can be replaced after a waiting period. Each person reads every rule, including its catch, and signs for their own seat.

containsText.text: Widget factory lets anyone pay in BCH for widgets!

replaceAllText.replaceText: A CashScript covenant holds each Venn. CashTokens carry its state: a rules NFT plus one card per member with their key, roles and remaining budget.

containsText.text: And users can escrow their widget investment funds as part of the widget marketplace.

replaceAllText.replaceText: A payment must rewrite that card in the same transaction, so the BCH VM itself refuses overspending.
